behavior: `RadioGroup` never exposes the input of a disabled radio in `inputElement`. It exposes the checked input when that input is enabled, or else the first enabled input in the document, or else `null`. A radio or a group that becomes disabled thus gives the same `inputElement` as one that is disabled at the mount. A form library that focuses `inputElement` for an error then focuses an enabled radio. Base UI keeps the input in `inputRef` when its radio or its group becomes disabled, and skips it when they are disabled at the mount. The browser does not focus a disabled input, so such a library moves no focus.
